parameters.content:
## Eval harness: score any n8n pipeline

Gives the nodes between a fixed head and tail two doors: n8n Evaluations and an outside prompt optimizer. Both send the same case and get the same answer.

### How it works
1. An Evaluation run reads one sheet row (`id`, `query`, `ground_truth`, optional `prompt`, `schema`); an optimizer posts `{case_id, input, expected, prompt, params}` to the webhook.
2. Parse Eval Input turns both into `case_id`, `input`, `prompt` and `params`. The expected answer is left out, so your nodes never see it.
3. Your nodes in the middle answer the case; by default one LLM step does.
4. Build Answer reads the answer from `output`, `text` or the whole last item, cut to `params.answer_fields` when given.
5. An Evaluation run scores the answer against `ground_truth` and writes it back; a webhook call gets `{case_id, answer, raw}`.

### Setup steps
- [ ] Paste your nodes between Parse Eval Input and Build Answer, or keep the default LLM step and select its model credential.
- [ ] Put your production prompt in place of `''` in your prompt expression, so an empty `prompt` runs it.
- [ ] If your last node returns an object and callers send no `answer_fields`, name the graded field in Build Answer.
- [ ] Add a header-auth credential (`X-Eval-Secret`) to When Called by Optimizer.
- [ ] Select the dataset sheet in both sheet nodes and add the columns `predicted` and `score`.
- [ ] Keep the row limit at 3 until one run's storage is known.

Guide: https://github.com/runfish5/micro-services/tree/main/projects/n8n/shared

## Two ways in

A sheet row or one optimizer call becomes the same case: `case_id`, `input`, `prompt`, `params`. The expected answer stays out.

## Your nodes go here

Read `$('Parse Eval Input').first().json`: `input`, `prompt` (empty = your production prompt) and `params`. The last node's `output`, `text` or JSON is the answer.

## Score or reply

The answer is read from the last node. Evaluation runs score it against `ground_truth` and write to the sheet; webhook calls get it back.

nodes.notes:
Dataset columns: id, query, ground_truth; optional prompt, schema (JSON text). Extra columns are ignored.
maxRows 3 is the first-run probe; raise it once one run's storage is known.

nodes.name: When Called by Optimizer
nodes.notes:
Header X-Eval-Secret. Body: { case_id, input, expected, prompt, params }.
prompt "" = the production prompt. expected is never passed on: the caller grades.

The middle reads $('Parse Eval Input').first().json:
case_id: text
input: text, or an object when the row is JSON object text
prompt: candidate prompt, '' = production
params: { output_schema, answer_fields } when sent
expected is left out on purpose.

nodes.name: Build Answer

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify((() => { const c = $('Parse Eval Input').first().json; const fields = (c.params.answer_fields || []).length ? c.params.answer_fields : []; const j = $json; const pick = [j.output, j.text, j.answer, j.response, j.content, j.message && j.message.content, j.choices && j.choices[0] && j.choices[0].message && j.choices[0].message.content].find(v => v !== undefined && v !== null); const raw = pick !== undefined ? pick : (j.error ? { error: j.error } : j); const asObject = v => { if (v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v)) return v; if (typeof v !== 'string') return null; try { const o = JSON.parse(v.trim().replace(/^```(?:json)?\s*/i, '').replace(/\s*```$/, '')); return o && typeof o === 'object' && !Array.isArray(o) ? o : null; } catch (e) { return null; } }; const text = v => v === undefined || v === null ? '' : typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v).trim(); const o = asObject(raw); const answer = j.error && pick === undefined ? '' : fields.length && o ? (fields.length === 1 ? text(o[fields[0]]) : JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(fields.map(k => [k, o[k] ?? ''])))) : text(raw); return { case_id: c.case_id, answer: answer, raw: raw }; })()) }}

nodes.notes:
Reads the last middle node: output, text, answer, response, content, message.content or choices[0].message.content, else the whole item. An error item answers ''.
answer_fields: one field = its value, several = JSON of exactly them.
Default when the caller sends none: the [] after answer_fields, e.g. ['requires_action'].

nodes.name: Score Answer

assignments.name: score
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const norm = v => (v !== null && typeof v === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(v) : String(v ?? '')).trim().toLowerCase(); const parse = v => { if (typeof v !== 'string') return v; try { return JSON.parse(v); } catch (e) { return v; } }; const gold = parse($('When Running Evaluation').first().json.ground_truth); const answer = $('Build Answer').first().json.answer; if (!gold || typeof gold !== 'object' || Array.isArray(gold)) return norm(answer) === norm(gold) ? 1 : 0; const keys = Object.keys(gold).filter(k => gold[k] !== null); if (!keys.length) return 0; const parsed = parse(answer); const got = parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' ? parsed : (keys.length === 1 ? { [keys[0]]: answer } : {}); return keys.filter(k => [].concat(gold[k]).map(norm).includes(norm(got[k]))).length / keys.length; })() }}

nodes.notes:
ground_truth text: exact match, case and outer spaces ignored (1 or 0).
ground_truth JSON object {field: [accepted, ...]}: share of its non-null fields right.
